title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Earning Accelerator on Marlowe Rewards Fulfilment-Order Points
content:
When Marlowe Rewards points are credited on a reservation fulfilment order that never earned them, a member holding a Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan in force earns at a higher multiplier.

## The accelerator

| Unlimited plan held by the member | Plan status | Accelerator added to the multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| An annual plan: Unlimited Student Annual, Unlimited Standard Annual, Unlimited Express Annual or Unlimited Next-Day Annual | active or cancellation pending | 0.25 |
| A monthly plan: Unlimited Standard Monthly or Unlimited Express Monthly | active or cancellation pending | 0.10 |
| Any other position: no plan, or a plan in trial, past due or expired | any | none |

## How it acts

The accelerator is added to the multiplier the qualifying spend is multiplied by, before the product is rounded to a whole point.

## Illustration (hypothetical tier multiplier of 1.50 and qualifying spend of 100.00)

| Member's plan | Multiplier | Points before rounding |
|---|---|---|
| Unlimited Express Annual, active | 1.75 | 175 |
| Unlimited Standard Monthly, cancellation pending | 1.60 | 160 |
| No Unlimited plan | 1.50 | 150 |
